# feega CLI

CLI for feega — an infinite canvas of typed nodes (text, image, video, doc, iframe, social
feed, social post mockup, products, ads) — from the terminal. Brand-scoped; MCP is the
org-scoped, richer surface for agents (see docs/mcp.md and skills/feega/references/tools.md).

## Installation

```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreabuttarelli/feega/main/cli/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

## Commands

### Overview
- `feega brands` — List all brands
- `feega dashboard <slug>` — Full brand dashboard
- `feega status <slug>` — Detailed status
- `feega health` — Check Supabase / Gemini / Zernio API status

### Posts
- `feega content <slug> [--status <status>]` — List/filter posts (status: pending_user, approved, scheduled, published, failed)
- `feega content <slug> --clear <status>` — Bulk-delete posts with that status
- `feega approve <slug> [--all] [--dry]` — Approve pending posts
- `feega post <slug> <id>` — Show post: text, media, platforms
- `feega post <slug> <id> edit [--caption|--title|--link|--subreddit|--firstComment|--imagePrompt|--media|--format|--platforms|--platformCaption|--slot|--product]` — Edit fields (no render, no credits)
- `feega post <slug> <id> render` — Generate the missing image from the prompt
- `feega post <slug> <id> approve` — Approve single post
- `feega post <slug> <id> publish` — Publish immediately
- `feega post <slug> <id> reschedule --scheduledFor "2026-06-20T10:00"` — Reschedule
- `feega post <slug> <id> reject` — Delete pending post

Editing a SCHEDULED post re-syncs it to Zernio automatically, so what goes out is what you edited.

### Calendar
- `feega calendar <slug> [--month YYYY-MM]` — Monthly scheduled posts

### Products
- `feega products <slug> [list|sync]` — List catalog, or re-import from the connected store (Shopify/Woo)

### Ads
- `feega ads <slug>` — Ad campaigns, spend, metrics + boost candidates
- `feega ads <slug> --sync` — Sync ad accounts + metrics
- `feega ads <slug> --propose` — Propose boosts from top organic posts
- `feega ads <slug> --remix` — Remix competitor/trending ads into ranked creative briefs
- `feega ads <slug> --create --name "..." --headline "..." [--platform metaads|googleads] [--budget N]` — Create a standalone proposal
- `feega ads <slug> --approve <id> [--budget N] [--goal ...]` — Approve + launch on Zernio
- `feega ads <slug> --pause <id>` — Pause a campaign (all its creatives)
- `feega ads <slug> --resume <id>` — Resume a paused campaign
- `feega ads <slug> --pause <id> --ad <adId>` — Pause one creative only (A/B)
- `feega ads <slug> --resume <id> --ad <adId>` — Resume one creative only
- `feega ads <slug> --duplicate <id>` — Duplicate a campaign (paused copy as new proposal)
- `feega ads <slug> --delete <id>` — Delete a campaign on the platform (history kept)
- `feega ads <slug> --reject <id>` — Reject a proposal

### Account & billing
- `feega upgrade <slug>` — Open plan upgrade page

### System
- `feega login [--email --password | --password-stdin]` — Authenticate
- `feega logout` — Clear the local session
- `feega update` — Update CLI to latest version
- `feega --help` — Show help

## Environment

- `PUBLIC_APP_URL` — Backend URL (default: http://localhost:5173, falls back to https://feega.app)

## Auth

Run `feega login` once to authenticate via browser, or non-interactively with `feega login --email you@example.com --password …` (or `--password-stdin` to keep the password out of shell history and `ps`). Session is saved in `~/.config/feega/session.json`.

## MCP

MCP server in `mcp/` — stdio + Streamable HTTP. Same OAuth identity as the CLI (no static API tokens).
Twelve tools, org-scoped: `query`, `insert_row`, `update_row`, `delete_row`, `describe_node_types`,
`list_posts`, `create_post`, `set_post_status`, `list_ad_campaigns`, `create_ad_campaign`,
`approve_ad_campaign`, `run_node_generation`.

```bash
bun run mcp          # stdio
bun run mcp:http     # http://localhost:8787/mcp
```

Remote (Vercel / `mcp.feega.app`): `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Full map: `docs/mcp.md`,
`skills/feega/references/tools.md`.

## Observability (Sentry + Supabase)

MCP HTTP logs/errors → Vercel stderr, optional Sentry (`SENTRY_DSN`), optional Supabase `mcp_logs` (`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`). See `docs/mcp.md`.

## Architecture

The CLI is a thin HTTP client. All operations go through `/api/v1/*` endpoints. No direct database access. No secrets embedded.

```
CLI  → HTTP → /api/v1/brands/:slug/*  → Supabase → Database
MCP  → HTTP → /api/v1/org/*           → Supabase → Database
```
